== Description ==
Meet the Farmer!
Season 1 Episode 4

Full Video with subtitles in all game languages. Go to the settings of the video in the bottom right side of the video and choose the language from the list.


Meet the farmers in Hay Day from all around the world! 

In this 4th episode of the series you'll get to meet Colleen, who is an artist living in St. Louis, Missouri, US! Learn how she has taken Hay Day into her everyday life as a way to relax, make friends and even try new cooking recipes!
